name: Shri Hardeep Singh Puri
education: B.A. (Hons.) History, First in order of Merit; M.A.(History), First class Educated at University of Delhi, Delhi
profession: Lecturer in History, St. Stephen’s College, University of Delhi and Retired Diplomat
permanent_address: B-17, First Floor, Westend Colony,Rao Tula Ram Marg, New Delhi 110057
books: (i) Perilous Interventions: The Security Council and the Politics of Chaos (Penguin Random House India), January 2019, (ii) India's Trade Policy Dilemma and the Role of Domestic Reform (Carnegie India), 2017 and (iii) Delusional Politics (Penguin Random House India), January 2019; Edited the anthology, 'Delhi University: Celebrating 100 Glorious years' (Rupa Publications), 2022
social_activities: Has written and been published widely in areas spanning international relations, issues related to peace and security and trade policy
hobbies: Member, (i) India Habitat Centre, (ii) India International Centre, (iii) Noida Golf Course, (iv) Delhi Golf Club Ltd., (v) Gymkhana Club and (vi) Delhi and District Cricket Association
countries_visited: Myanmar, U.S.A., Brazil, Switzerland, U.K., Sri Lanka, Japan and several other countries across the globe
other_information: Senior Adviser, International Peace Institute (IPI), New York (U.S.A.), June - Dec. 2013; Vice-President, International Peace Institute (IPI) New York (U.S.A.) and Secretary-General of the Independent Commission on Multilateralism (ICM), Dec. 2013 - March 2016; one of the few Indians to preside over the United Nations Security Council and to have Chaired its Counter-Terrorism Committee; delivered a public lecture on ‘India and the Western Liberal Democratic Order’ at the Nehru Memorial Museum and Library, New Delhi, 23 January 2017; nominated by the Prime Minister to participate in Third Asia Pacific Water Summit in Myanmar, 11-12 December, 2017; Chaired the Governing Council of UN Habitat in Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia) from 7-9 February 2018; participated in the High - level Political Forum on Sustainable Development at the United Nations in New York(U.S.A.) from 11-16 July 2018
